One of the starter towers.|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|Shoot enemies from large distances.|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Sniper''' is one of the two starter towers obtained upon joining the game for the first time, along with the [[Scout]]. It is a long-ranged cliff tower with a slow firerate, possessing high damage per shot. Its utility comes from its very long range, allowing the '''Sniper''' to target enemies from far away. It deals high damage at a rather slow firerate. Slower enemies are vulnerable to the '''Sniper''' for long periods of time due to the '''Sniper's''' range, but faster enemies may be able to bypass it. Because the '''Sniper''' is a cliff tower, it can detect [[Flying]] enemies. The '''Sniper''' can also detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemies at Level 2+ and damage [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] enemies at Level 3+. It is immune to all stuns by default. The '''Sniper''' is considered a solid early to mid-game tower, being able to take down many enemy types due to its triple detections, making it useful for [[Hardcore Mode]] and other harder gamemodes. Towards late game, the '''Sniper''' becomes inefficient against stronger enemies like the [[Slow Boss]] and the [[Fallen Giant]] due to its insufficient damage output, or fast enemies like the [[Bolt]] and the [[Yeti]] due to their speed, so it is recommended to get a stronger tower by then. The slow firerate can result in you being easily overwhelmed later on in the game by hordes. *The '''Sniper''' has lower DPS than other starter towers, but to compensate, it has a relatively long range, so it can keep shooting enemies for a while. **You can pair this with the [[Commander]] or the [[Medic]] so that it will shoot faster. *Later on in the game, to maximize damage, you should change the '''Sniper's''' targeting to ''Strongest'', or replace them with stronger towers like [[Ranger]]. *The [[DJ Booth]] can easily expand the range of the '''Sniper''' to cover most, if not all, of the map. *The '''Sniper''' can be used as a cheap way to deal with [[Flying]] enemies that appear early on during the game. **It can also damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies at Level 3+, making it rather useful against flying and lead combinations like [[Lead Balloon]], although there are better alternatives, like the [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Military Base]]. *The '''Sniper''' is one of the few towers that can damage all enemies, no matter their immunities, when upgraded to Level 3+. **Despite it being able to damage all enemies, it is generally not worth using the '''Sniper''' late on during the game due to its low DPS and slow firerate. *The '''Sniper''' has no placement limit, requiring many placements to be effective, therefore other cliff towers should not be brought due to the limited cliff space available in most maps occupied by the snipers. **Towards late-game, the '''Snipers''' can be sold to make space for other cliff towers, but this is not recommended unless absolutely necessary since it is rather time consuming and results in a general loss in cash and total dps. ==Trivia== *When the game was in Alpha, the '''Sniper's''' upgrade stats were not displayed on its upgrade description. It was simply referred to as "sans long gun". *Weirdly, the '''Sniper''' costs {{Coins|100}} to unlock, according to the store, despite being given for free. **This is because prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], the '''Sniper''' used to cost {{Coins|100}} to purchase from the store. *The '''Sniper''' is also the only cliff tower to have no placement limit. *The '''Sniper''' is loosely based on the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Sniper|Sniper]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Sniper''' used to appear alongside the [[Pyromancer]], [[Scout]], [[Commander]] and [[Minigunner]] on the "Triumph" screen before the [[v1.8.0|Community Maps Update]]. *Formerly, the '''Sniper''' used to have the longest range in the entire game not counting any admin-exclusive towers.
